n: Warren A. Cowdery, Oliver Cowdery’s older brother, is called as presiding high priest over the Saints in and around Freedom, New York.

f.g: Older brother of Oliver Cowdery; he later served as a Church clerk and scribe in Kirtland.
A town in western New York.

n: He is to preach the gospel and warn people, both locally and in neighboring counties.
He should devote his whole time to this sacred calling, seeking God’s kingdom first; what he needs will be provided, for a laborer deserves his support.

f.w: seeking diligently the kingdom of heaven
the laborer is worthy of his hire

n: The Lord’s coming is near and will surprise the world like a thief at night.

f.w: as a thief in the night

n: So prepare—“gird up your loins”—to be children of light, and that day won’t catch you unprepared.

f.g: Tie up long robes to be ready for action; be prepared.

n: Heaven rejoiced when Warren submitted to God’s rule and left behind worldly schemes.
He is blessed, and God will have mercy. Despite the pride of his heart, God will lift him up if he humbles himself.
God will give him grace and confidence to stand; if he stays a faithful witness and light to the Church, a crown awaits him in the Father’s mansions.
